title: Operating margin improvement from cost leverage
question: What happened to operating margin between FY2024 and FY2025, and what drove it?

gold_answer.summary: Operating margin rose from 10.0% to 13.0%, up 3.0 percentage points. Gross margin was unchanged at 40.0%, so the whole improvement came from operating costs growing only 3.5% while revenue grew 15.0% (operating costs fell from 30.0% to 27.0% of revenue).
gold_answer.main_driver: Operating costs grew far slower than revenue; gross margin did not contribute.

design_note: Baseline. Tests whether the model checks gross margin before attributing the improvement, rather than vaguely crediting 'improved profitability'.
